subject: Invoice delivery & billing contact handoff — portal vs. temporary email push
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@megacorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Cc: AP Team <ap@megacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice delivery + VAT evidence — what do you need from us?

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from our AP team as we onboard Redwood: we need to confirm how invoices will be delivered and what you require for VAT / tax evidence on the first invoice. Our options on the AP side are:

- Accept invoices pushed to ap@megacorp.com (PDF) with invoices-archive@megacorp.com cc'd
- Pull from a supplier portal (preferred if available) — we can accept portal-only with an API push to our system
- SFTP drop (less preferred)

A couple of constraints:
- We prefer to avoid duplicate emails in the AP inbox (if portal is primary, can you suppress the email copy after cutover?)
- We need the VAT ID + registered billing address on the invoice PDF or uploaded to the portal for reconciliation
- PO handling: we will send a PO number on the first invoice; can you map line items to a PO field?

Can you send a short proposal for the recommended flow and what we should expect during a 30-day onboarding window (temporary fallbacks, who to copy, sample invoice format)?

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of AP, MegaCorp
elena.ruiz@megacorp.com
AP team: ap@megacorp.com

——
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@megacorp.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@megacorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery + VAT evidence — what do you need from us?

Hi Elena — great to hear and welcome to Redwood. Below is a pragmatic approach that balances your desire to avoid duplicates with a smooth onboarding.

Recommended delivery plan (short):
1) Primary: Redwood Billing Portal (secure, searchable) — we post invoices there and push a metadata notification (webhook) to your AP system. Portal will be the canonical source.
2) Onboarding fallback (30 days): PDF email push to ap@megacorp.com while portal enrollment completes. We can include invoices-archive@megacorp.com on the first two invoices for reconciliation and then suppress thereafter.
3) Long-term fallback: SFTP or API push for your ERP if needed.

Data / VAT requirements:
- We will include VAT ID, registered billing address, and company registration on the invoice PDF and in the portal fields.
- First invoice: we can attach VAT proof (certificate) to the portal and include the document in the first emailed PDF as well.

PO handling: we can accept a PO number as a top-level metadata field. Our billing system will include a PO field and we can map line items on request; by default we include the PO on the invoice header for reconciliation.

Temporary rules we propose for the 30-day window:
- Day 0: sign billing enrollment (DocuSign link below).
- Days 1–14: portal token and metadata exchange; we push PDFs to ap@megacorp.com with invoices-archive@megacorp.com cc'd.
- Days 15–30: confirm portal receipts and remove invoices-archive cc (email copies suppressed).

Attachments: invoice_sample-Redwood-202706.pdf (example), einv_schema_v1.xml (field map).

If that works I’ll kick off the enrollment and loop in Finance (Marissa) to confirm the PDF fallback model and signed acceptance for the portal-only after day 30.

DocuSign for enrollment: https://www.docusign.com/req/ABC123
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Payments & Billing
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.inference

——

Key asks: portal primary; temporary PDF push to ap@megacorp.com for up to 30 days; invoices-archive@megacorp.com on first two invoices; suppress email copies after confirmation. Also need to confirm we can attach VAT evidence on first invoice and expose a PO metadata field.

Can you confirm we’re OK with:
- 30-day onboarding PDF fallback for portal enrollments
- attaching VAT evidence on first invoice (and portal upload)
- removing cc after confirmation (cc suppression option)

If yes I’ll send the DocuSign and onboarding checklist to Elena.

Thanks,
Kim

Kim / Ben — confirmed from Finance:

- Portal primary is preferred and supported. We will mark portal as canonical.
- We approve a 30-calendar-day PDF fallback for onboarding. During that period we will allow the first two invoices to CC invoices-archive@megacorp.com to help AP reconcile. After AP confirms portal receipts we will stop emailing.
- VAT evidence: we require either (a) VAT certificate uploaded to the portal and referenced on the invoice, or (b) the signed VAT certificate attached to the first emailed PDF. Either is acceptable; please choose the portal upload as the primary path.
- PO mapping: we will accept a top-level PO metadata field; mapping of line items can be done later if MegaCorp requests it.

Action items for me: create a HubSpot billing note and attach the sample invoice; prepare the enrollment DocuSign and turn on the PDF fallback flag for this account during provisioning.

I’ll proceed once you share MegaCorp’s AP contact and confirm we should send the DocuSign.

Thanks,
